6.message:
fix(1.8): resolve TileState reflectively to stop NoClassDefFoundError on every block break

org.bukkit.block.TileState is a 1.14+ class; referencing it directly in
isValidBreakEvent crashed BlockBreakListener on 1.8.8 for every block break.
Now resolved via Class.forName, short-circuiting to false when absent.
6.author: intisy (Finn Birich)
